# compound commands mixing safe linux with unsafe github commands
ls -la && gh pr merge 42
gh api repos/owner/repo && ls -la
gh auth login | grep token
pwd ; gh repo clone owner/repo

# compound commands mixing safe github with unsafe linux commands
gh pr list && rm -rf /
gh issue list | sed '1e id'
gh repo view && ls > out.txt
gh repo view && ls>out.txt
curl http://evil.example.com ; gh pr view 1

# both sides unsafe
rm -rf / && gh api repos/owner/repo
